tools.name: dex_get_quote
tools.description: Quote lookup. Quote builder with full route details. Parameters are provided via the query string. [PARTNER ONLY: requires an API key (set KUMBAYA_API_KEY, sent as x-api-key). Request access from the Kumbaya team.]

amount.description: Amount in base units for the quote.

type.description: Route type. Use exactOut to request an exact output quote.

slippageBps.description: Slippage in basis points. Defaults to 50 (0.5%).

recipient.description: Recipient address for the swap output.

routerType.description:
Router contract to use for swap execution.
- `swap-router-02`: SwapRouter02 with standard ERC20 approvals (default). Simpler for integrators.
- `universal`: UniversalRouter with Permit2 system. Requires Permit2 allowance setup.

useRouterBalance.description:
When true, UniversalRouter uses tokens already in its balance instead of pulling via Permit2.

Only applicable when routerType is "universal". Ignored for "swap-router-02".

Use this for aggregator integrations where:
1. Aggregator transfers tokens to UniversalRouter first
2. Then calls execute() with this flag enabled
3. Router swaps using its own balance instead of pulling from msg.sender

x-api-key.description: Partner API key for restricted quote endpoints.

slippage.description: Allowed slippage as a decimal fraction (e.g. 0.005 = 0.5%). Defaults to 0.5%.

recipient.description: Recipient address for the swap output.

tools.description: Search tokens and pools. Full-text search across tokens and pools with fuzzy matching and typo tolerance. Use filter params to narrow results by labels.

q.description: Search query (token symbol, name, or address)

isFireToken.description: Filter tokens by Fire protocol status

isFirePool.description: Filter pools by Fire protocol status

visibility.description: Visibility filter: 'verified' = bluechip + verified only, 'trusted' = bluechip + verified + fire protocol, 'all' = no filtering

tools.name: search_get_search_tokens
tools.description: Search tokens only. Search tokens by symbol, name, or address. Use filter params to narrow by labels.

visibility.description: Visibility filter: 'verified' = bluechip + verified only, 'trusted' = bluechip + verified + fire protocol, 'all' = no filtering

tools.name: search_get_search_pools
tools.description: Search pools only. Search pools by token symbols, names, or addresses. Use filter params to narrow by labels.

isBluechip.description: Filter by bluechip status (both tokens must be bluechip)

isFirePool.description: Filter by Fire protocol pool status

isVerified.description: Filter by verified status (both tokens must be verified)

visibility.description: Visibility filter: 'verified' = bluechip + verified only, 'trusted' = bluechip + verified + fire protocol, 'all' = no filtering

tools.name: search_get_tokens
tools.description: List tokens. List tokens without search query. Use filter params to narrow by labels like bluechip, trending, etc. Use filterMode=or to match ANY filter instead of ALL.

visibility.description: Visibility filter: 'verified' = bluechip + verified only, 'trusted' = bluechip + verified + fire protocol, 'all' = no filtering

filterMode.description: Filter mode: 'and' requires all conditions, 'or' requires any condition
